truth.root_cause: The shared segment-filter value union admits the structured survey-interaction value for unrelated filter kinds, allowing an object to reach evaluators that expect scalar values.
The picker hides already-gated surveys but neither clears retained IDs nor enforces a circular-reference invariant on the write path.
surveyScope any includes the survey being gated, while neither segment writes nor survey assignment reject the resulting self-dependency.
The generic in-memory evaluateSegment chain omits surveyInteraction leaves, silently corrupting segment membership.
The survey-reference action and picker materialize an unbounded workspace survey list and accept an unbounded ID collection.
A malformed in-memory segment can throw into the outer catch and return an empty result, erasing memberships already computed for other segments.
The Prisma filter construction does not preserve mixed AND/OR precedence, violating the PR's in-memory/Prisma parity objective.
